description: K1 PROOF ONLY, NEVER DELIVER (o deliver recusa esta pasta e esta marca antes de registrar a tarefa). K1 (Manage Dependencies headless), prova VIVA (leitura) + offline: acrescenta HMISPdfText.ExtractPdfText (com a structure PdfPageText) e a entidade User do (System) a uma copia do HMISJHA_CS publicado (v5578), ligados a assinaturas capturadas por `anvil signature` no SS4 (lease so leitura), e prova o uso numa action PRIVADA de prova, sem inputs, que nunca e entregue: chama ExtractPdfText e le so o registro do proprio usuario da sessao (GetUserId()); nao chama Login, nao recebe UserId e nao cria nada publico. O unico consumidor da action e um timer SEM agendamento (uma server action nao publica sem consumidor recebe UnusedUserAction, ServiceStudio.Model Flows.cs:8768-8776, e a regra N4 do gate conta todo aviso). Nunca e entregue: a escrita viva (L5) usa um job proprio sobre um modulo ZZ de teste, com --capture-producer e as palavras de autorizacao. Registro e comandos: docs/proofs/2026-09-26-o11-manage-dependencies.md.

actions.name: ProbeK1PdfTextAndUser
actions.description: K1 PROBE ONLY, NEVER DELIVER: private proof that the imported dependencies are usable. Calls HMISPdfText ExtractPdfText (typed by the imported PdfPageText structure) on an empty PDF and reads the signed-in user's own (System) User record by GetUserId(); it takes no input, signs nobody in and writes nothing.

outputs.name: Pages
outputs.description: Text of each page, typed by the PdfPageText structure imported with ExtractPdfText.

outputs.name: IsSessionUserActive
outputs.description: Whether the signed-in user's own (System) User record is active; proves the User entity reference.

ops.value: Reads only the signed-in user's own (System) User record (Id = GetUserId()), at most one row.
K1 PROBE ONLY, NEVER DELIVER: no schedule, so it never runs by itself; it exists only as the consumer of the private probe action (a private action without one gets the UnusedUserAction warning).
